2609.04083.title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
2609.04083.paper_summary: MLLM-based embedding models remain limited in compositional retrieval, often failing to distinguish scenes containing the same concepts but different attribute-object bindings. Yet the same backbone can resolve such distinctions when used as a cross-attentive reranker, motivating us to distill its compositional judgments into the embedding model. We propose CORE, which synthesizes candidate lists spanning five compositional matching levels and introduces a Rank-KL objective that trains the embedding model to reproduce the reranker's fine-grained ranking. We further introduce a graded evaluation protocol and compare contrastive learning, pairwise CoSENT, and listwise Rank-KL under the same data and tuning budget. Our comparison shows that both CoSENT and Rank-KL use the multi-level supervision more effectively than contrastive learning, with Rank-KL achieving the strongest overall performance. Across three compositional reasoning benchmarks (COLA, SUGARCREPE++, NEGBENCH), CORE-RERANKER-8B achieves an 82.7% total average, outperforming Jina-Reranker by 10.7 points, while CORE-EMBED-8B achieves the best total average (0.666) among all evaluated embedding models. The improvements transfer to the MCMR benchmark without sacrificing retrieval performance on COCO and Flickr30K.
2609.04083.paper_summary_zh: MLLM 基於嵌入模型在組合檢索方面仍然有限，常常無法區分包含相同概念但不同屬性-物件綁定的場景。<lb/>然而，當作為跨注意力重排序器使用時，相同的骨幹可以解決這些區別，這激勵我們將其組合判斷提煉到嵌入模型中。<lb/>我們提出了 CORE，它合成了跨越五個組合匹配層級的候選列表，並引入了一個 Rank-KL 目標，該目標訓練嵌入模型以重現重排序器的細粒度排名。<lb/>我們進一步引入了一個分級評估協議，並在相同的數據和調整預算下比較對比學習、成對 CoSENT 和列表 Rank-KL。<lb/>我們的比較顯示，CoSENT 和 Rank-KL 在多層次監督的使用上比對比學習更有效，且 Rank-KL 實現了最強的整體表現。<lb/>在三個組合推理基準（COLA、SUGARCREPE++、NEGBENCH）中，CORE-RERANKER-8B 獲得了 82.7% 的總平均，超越了 Jina-Reranker 10.7 分，而 CORE-EMBED-8B 在所有評估的嵌入模型中獲得了最佳總平均（0.666）。<lb/>這些改進在不犧牲 COCO 和 Flickr30K 的檢索性能的情況下，轉移到 MCMR 基準。
